values.meaning: Magic Damage per Arcane Barrage cast

values.binNote: No bin row carries this stack cap; NumberOfShots=[4/5/6] is a different value (max recasts, not max Arcane Perfection stacks).
Bin also has DamageDelay=0.5, a different (older/unused) missile-impact delay value that disagrees with the wiki's stated 0.6s recast delay; wiki's 0.6 matches CDPerShot.

values.meaning: Cooldown refund fraction if no recast used

mechanics.claim: Xerath channels for up to 10 seconds, gaining the ability to recast after the first 0.5 seconds within the duration.
mechanics.quote: channels for up to 10 seconds, gaining the ability to recast ''Rite of the Arcane'' multiple times after {{fd|0.5}} seconds within the duration

mechanics.claim: If the channel ends without using any recasts, half of the ability's cooldown is refunded.
mechanics.quote: If ''Rite of the Arcane'' ends without any of the recasts being used, half of its {{sti|cooldown}} is refunded.

mechanics.claim: Each Arcane Barrage recast has a fixed 0.6s cooldown that is unaffected by ability haste, in addition to a 0.6s missile travel delay before impact.
mechanics.quote: '''Xerath''' catapults an arcane missile that strikes the target location after a {{rutngt|0.6}} delay

mechanics.claim: Hitting at least one enemy champion with a cast grants a stack of Arcane Perfection during the channel, up to a max, which increases the damage of subsequent Arcane Barrage casts.
mechanics.quote: Hitting at least one enemy champion grants a stack of ''Arcane Perfection'' during the channel, stacking up to a maximum amount. Each stack increases ''Arcane Barrage's'' damage.

mechanics.claim: The cast that grants an Arcane Perfection stack does not itself benefit from the stack's increased damage; only later casts do.
mechanics.quote: ''Arcane Barrage'' will not apply its increased damage per stack to the cast that granted the stack.

mechanics.claim: Each recast counts as a separate ability activation, triggering on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts only after the channel/recast sequence ends, not on initial cast.
